children: Middleby presented 2028 targets, announced exit of its brewing business and updated FY2026 guidance at the Jefferies Global Industrials Conference.
Announced exit of Brewing (SS Brewtech, Deutsche Beverage, Wild Goose) to complete by end of 2026; ~ $24M 2025 net sales, ~$9M 2025 adjusted EBITDA loss.
Reiterated 2028 targets: 3–6% organic net sales CAGR, 200–400 bps adjusted EBITDA margin expansion, 10–15% adjusted EPS CAGR and ~$400M FCF run rate.
Updated FY2026 guidance: Net sales $2.48–2.53B, Adjusted EBITDA $572–588M, Adjusted EPS $6.73–6.89 (midpoint growth vs 2025 noted).
Reported +8% H1 2026 organic net sales and said growth is broad-based; beverage platforms and hot-side products drove orders and sales.
Outlined margin bridge: ~80% of 2028 margin improvement within operational control (lean, SKU rationalization, facility consolidation); ~20% from growth/operating leverage.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Middleby outlines 2028 targets, exits brewing and raises FY2026 guidance after Jefferies presentation
